The roadside stand is open 24/7 on the honor system. Our eggs come from a variety of breeds and in a variety of colors. We are a regenerative and permaculture farm and operate under organic conditions. Grow Happy!

The Farm at the Pines is a 5th Generation Family Farm. We have adopted a holistic approach in attempting to participate in the most sustainable agricultural practices. We are licensed to sell from our farm direct to our consumers. We sell 100% Grass Fed and Grass Finished Angus Beef and Farm Raised Berkshire Pork. Customers can purchase individual cuts of our nutritional Grass Fed Beef or order custom quarters and halves. Our Berkshire Pork is available for purchase by the individual cut. All of our cattle are born and raised on our farm. Our Angus Cattle and Berkshire Hogs are processed at a local USDA Inspected Facility located just over 5 miles from our Farm.
